name: Soudeur
description: Soudeur réparant les armures et les équipements endommagés directement sur le terrain pendant les pauses entre deux combats.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy layered salvaged space mining suit reinforced with welded steel plates from signage and vehicle hulls, asymmetric plating secured with massive duct tape patches and cable ties, exposed pneumatic lines and hydraulic conduits, heavy canvas and synthetic fiber underlayers stained with coolant and grease, industrial modular harness system laden with welding torch holders, tool pouches, and magnetic tool racks, cracked pressurized helmet with scratched opaque visor and mounted welding goggles, gauntlets reinforced with metal scrap plating and integrated sparking igniters, magnetic boots for low-gravity traction
loadout.arsenal: Hybrid plasma cutting torch weaponized as both welding tool and close-combat flame projector, salvaged industrial rivet gun converted to pneumatic rapid-fire projectile weapon, heavy kinetic impact hammer with exposed copper coil for electromagnetic strikes, articulated welding arm mount for field armor repairs, improvised EMP device cobbled from stolen spacecraft capacitors and copper wire

attitude.behavior: Frontline combatant in aggressive assault stance, body coiled and twisted for maximum power delivery, weapon arm raised and locked with support hand bracing beneath, magnetic boots planted against buckled deck plating, opposite arm extended backward for balance counter-weight, slight crouch to absorb low-gravity momentum shifts, debris particles slowly drifting around frozen combat moment
attitude.emotion: Intense combat focus with wild determination, gritted teeth visible through cracked helmet visor, eyes locked on approaching threat with predatory calculation, sweat and coolant mixture dripping down scarred face, expression oscillating between controlled rage and professional assessment of tactical opportunity

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Complex multi-source setup with dominant blue-white plasma welding arc as key light creating intense localized illumination, secondary warm orange glow from molten metal rivers reflecting across all surfaces, fill light from distant exploding spacecraft structures, rim lighting from background fires and sparks creating silhouette separation, volumetric dust and particle effects with visible light shafts through debris clouds
color_and_light.mood: Chaotic desperate intensity, industrial brutal warfare, survival determination against overwhelming odds, visceral mechanical violence

camera.angle: Low dutch_angle with slight upward tilt to emphasize aggressive power stance, dramatic perspective distortion from wide-angle lens effect, camera positioned at combatant hip level looking toward enemy, slight motion blur on fastest moving debris particles to suggest frozen action moment

scenography.setting: Massive hollowed asteroid interior converted to sprawling scrapyard fortress, industrial cargo container modules stacked and welded into makeshift defensive structures, enormous spacecraft hull sections torn open revealing burning engine compartments, ruptured fuel tanks spilling cascading rivers of molten metal flowing across uneven deck plates, collapsing support structures sending continuous rain of twisted debris drifting in low-gravity arcs, improvised barricades constructed from spacecraft wreckage, hull fragments, and salvaged machinery, distant background showing more spacecraft engaging in zero-gravity dogfights, exposed asteroid rock walls scarred with mining operations and battle damage, floating debris field of torn metal sheets, broken tools, and shattered equipment slowly rotating in microgravity
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Heavy particulate debris cloud filling entire scene with slowly drifting metal fragments, constant cascade of sparks from clashing weapons and welding operations, molten metal splatter creating burning pools and flowing rivers with luminous surface, low-gravity dust motes catching all light sources creating volumetric haze, distant explosions illuminating background with orange fireballs, flickering unstable lighting from damaged power conduits, steam and gas venting from ruptured pressurized systems, electromagnetic interference causing occasional visual distortion around improvised electronics, zero-gravity fluid surface tension effects on floating metal droplets, smoke trails from burning wreckage creating atmospheric layers
